APP for State states on instructions that the investigation is complete and charge-sheet is expected to be filed on a proximate date.
2. Matter arises out of FIR No. 269/2024 PS Aman Vihar under Sections 498A/304B/34 IPC.
The deceased was the wife of the petitioner; they were married in 2012.

There were allegations by the mother that the deceased used to complain about dowry demands of an auto-rickshaw from the mother-in-law and the brother-in-law; subsequently she was found hanging at her mother's home on 22nd April, 2024.
It is noted that the mother-in-law and the brother-in-law, both co-accused have joined the investigation and have not been arrested but have been bound down.
3. APP for State submits that notice may be issued to the complainant.
